## Dangers

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- BVDOutbreakSize. 653 merged pull requests and about 32,000 lines of
  Julia since 19 May. Hard to keep track of
- Agents push towards complex, nested models and code
- Not written the way a person would write it. Hard to review and hard to
  hand on
- Wrong observation models and forecast bugs, caught by plots and domain
  knowledge
:::
::: {.column width="60%"}

folder by week, rising from about 1,500 in late May 2026 to 13,500 in

## Agents that search over models

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- Martinson et al. An LLM-guided tree search that writes forecasting
  code. Ranked first in the CDC FluSight hub, 2025/26
- Most candidates adapt models already in the hubs
- Bracher and Funk. The retrospective gain claimed earlier came from
  data revisions leaking into the evaluation
- 207,500 candidates scored. Compute and access few modelling groups
  have
:::
::: {.column width="60%"}
![](figures/agents-sai-arxiv.png){width="100%"
fig-alt="The arXiv abstract page for Prospective multi-pathogen disease
forecasting using autonomous LLM-guided tree search, by Martinson and
colleagues, submitted 15 May 2026."}
